output.brief: The August drop came from the chiller failure that left floors 6-8 hot from 4 to 19 August. It did not come from the housekeeping contractor or the kiosks. Floors 6-8 room comfort fell from 8.4 to 6.1, and their overall score fell to 6.8 for check-outs on 5-20 August. It recovered to 8.4 once cooling was restored. 56 of 74 negative comments were about heat, all from floors 6-8. Floors 1-5 stayed flat, within normal variation. Cleanliness scores and inspection pass rates did not move, and kiosk use and queue times were stable. The survey questionnaire was unchanged. So don't give notice to Orrin and don't pull the kiosks. Don't drop the floor 6-8 responses from the score either, because that would hide a real service failure. The 6% rate rise is unresolved. The value score dips every August, and the floors 1-5 dip is only slightly larger than usual. Hold the rate decision and keep watching the value score. Next steps: restore the deferred chiller maintenance on both chillers, keep critical spares on site, and write a guest-recovery protocol for cooling outages. The apology and half-night credit already went to affected guests. A further return-stay offer is optional. I'm fairly confident in this, around 85-90%, and I collected no extra evidence.
